body:
of all six re-records, speak now is the one that gets me in a different way — because Taylor wrote every single song on it herself, no co-writers, when she was 18 to 20. it's her quietly saying *the craft was always mine.* 🤍

and she didn't announce speak now (taylor's version) in a press release. she did it onstage, mid-show, during the eras tour in may 2023, in front of a whole stadium.

it landed july 7, 2023 with six vault tracks fans had waited over a decade to hear. the one that undid everyone: "castles crumbling," a duet with hayley williams none of us saw coming.

that's what i love about going through the re-records one at a time — every single one is hiding a story this big. tap through for the rest → longlivets.com/?lens=taylors-version&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
